N (ActionAttack) is not explicitly assigned in gcsim attackFrames[] for any hit — values are the second arg to InitNormalCancelSlice (AnimationLength / N-chain cancel). Recorded per Amber calibration convention.

O wind upon which all hymns and songs fly, bear these earth-walkers up into the sky!

Press
Summons a Wind Domain at the opponent's location, dealing AoE Anemo DMG and launching opponents into the air.

abilities.name: Wind's Grand Ode

_curatorNotes: gcsim internal/characters/venti/burst.go Burst(): `for i := range 20 { Tasks.Add(func(){ QueueAttackWithSnap(ai, snap, ap, 0, cb) }, 106+24*i) }` — 20 ticks, first at cast-frame 106, 24f interval (source comment: '8 second duration, tick every .4 second'). interval = 24/60 = 0.4s; firstTickDelay = (106 − spawnsAt 94)/60 = 0.2s. Agrees with the measured row (gcsim-frames-diff §5: Wind's Grand Ode 106f / 24f × 20).

Mult = burstDot[c.TalentLvlBurst()]; zz_venti.dm.go `burstDot` index 9 = 0.6768 → 67.68% ATK at talent level 10. Sidecar docs/curation/talents/venti.json burst row 'DoT' 10th value = 67.7% (genshin-db rounding of the same number).
ai.Element = attributes.Anemo, Durability 25 (1U), snapshot taken at frame 104 off ATK, hence stat 'atk'.

icdGate authored 2026-08-17 (ICD-group round b), closing the schema gap this note recorded: ICDGroupVenti's table entry (pkg/core/attacks/icd_groups.dm.go) is a 60f reset window with every 3rd hit applying. Measured 7 of 20 ticks applied against standard ICD's 8. ⚓ The period is standard's own; it is the 1s TIMER under a 24f interval that binds — the counter is reset constantly, so the window's first-hit slot does most of the work.

NOT authored: the Elemental Absorption series (burstAbsorbDot index 9 = 0.3384 → 33.84%, 15 ticks at 24f, burstAbsorbedTicks()). Its element is whichever of Pyro/Hydro/Cryo/Electro the Stormeye contacts — a runtime condition we cannot express — and it only fires when an absorb check succeeds.

Absorbed element (absorption round, 2026-10-17; gcsim 4eda9fc5f venti/burst.go:59-114): polls from 178f (the 4th Anemo tick) every 18f, 21 polls, P > H > E > C; on the lock an OWN stream of 15 hits × 24f STARTS AT the lock frame, 1U, ICDTagElementalBurst<El> on ICDGroupVenti (60f / every 3, cap 8) — its own counter, a different tag from the Anemo series. 33.84% at talent 10. ⚠️ gcsim queues all 15 at the lock and lets them outlive the Stormeye (a lock after 238f overruns cast+574); here the stream is cut at the Stormeye's end, which is believed to be the game's behaviour but is UNVERIFIED.

Elemental Absorption: burst absorbs one of Pyro/Hydro/Cryo/Electro once per use (absorb check begins at 4th anemo tick, frame 178; up to (480-24*4)/18 additional checks every 18f). Adds 15 absorbed-element ticks (24f interval) after absorption. Reviewer to decide effect-row representation.

Stormeye: 20 anemo ticks at frames 106, 130, ... 562 (106+24*i for i in 0..19); snapshot at frame 104. burstStart=94 is the constant used as spawnsAt — marks when the active window opens; first damage tick is at 106f. Duration 8s from gcsim comment ('8 second duration, tick every .4 second') and 20×24f = 480f = 8s.

Burst frames: InitAbilSlice(95) with comment '// Q -> N1/CA/E/D'. ActionJump=94 and ActionSwap=93 are explicitly set. ActionAttack, ActionSkill, ActionDash are NOT explicitly assigned (all default to AnimationLength=95f) — omitted per recipe rule. Reviewer may verify whether 95f should be recorded for those keys.
cooldownStartDelay: 81 frames from SetCDWithDelay(ActionBurst, 15*60, 81) in burst.go.

[Hexerei] Fandom 'Temporal Wind's Eulogy' (Witch's Eve Rite Passive, Change History: Luna III): with 2+ Hexerei in the party, while the Stormeye is active, for 4s after a nearby active character triggers Swirl that character's DMG +50% and the Stormeye deals 135% of its original DMG. The +50% DMG buff is authored in factionBonuses (gated teamFaction hexerei >=2 + state duringSummon); the 135% Stormeye multiplier is damage-only and intentionally unauthored.

↻ 2026-08-18: the burst note's closing sentence — 'factionBonuses effects are currently consumed only by the capability layer (Team Builder), not by the planner's buff windows; nothing in this array renders on the timeline yet' — is FALSE and has been since the faction-buffs round (2026-07-29 / 2026-08-15, docs/rounds/faction-bonuses-round.md). This file's C2 and C4 notes were updated then; this one was missed. factionBonuses ARE collected by the planner (`effectCollection.ts` `factionSourcesOf` / `factionProvenanceOf`), pooled with their own provenance split (`buffWindows.ts`), and drawn as a buff row labelled after the BONUS rather than the ability (`teamBuffRows.ts`). Measured 2026-08-18: parsing `Xiangling E > Venti Q N1…` with Venti + Mona + Xiangling (2 Hexerei) gives six 4s `allDmgBonus: 50` windows on Venti, one per pyroSwirl at 152/224/296/368/440/512f; the same rotation with only one Hexerei in the roster gives the same six swirls and ZERO windows, so the `teamFaction` gate resolves definitively in both directions.

⚠️ 2026-08-18, the part of this bonus that does NOT hold: the `state: duringSummon` half of the gate never resolves in buff-window evaluation. `evalCondition` returns null for any kit state that isn't onField/offField, every team-surface call in `buffWindows.ts` passes an empty resolvedStates set, and the pools drop only a DEFINITIVE false — so `all[teamFaction, duringSummon]` evaluates to null and the bar draws anyway. Measured: `Diluc E > Venti E` (2 Hexerei, no burst cast at all, so no Stormeye ever exists) still draws the +50% window at 89f off the pyroSwirl. The swirl TRIGGER is real — since the gauge round an `onReaction` bar only draws if the gauge actually produced that swirl — but the Stormeye requirement is optimistic. ⛔ Don't 'fix' it by dropping the `duringSummon` condition: it is correct data, it gates nothing today, and it is what will gate correctly the day state conditions reach `deriveBuffWindows`. This is the corpus-wide P15 class (88 state conditions over 36 characters), not a Venti defect.

nonHitting (non-hitting casts round, 2026-09-16 (docs/rounds/nonhitting-casts-round.md §1)): gcsim venti/burst.go:62-64: the stormeye ticks from f106 (after the 95f animation) are the Stormeye series.

constellations.name: Breeze of Reminiscence
_curatorNotes: Migrated to onHit ability:skill 2026-05-09 (F1). gcsim c2() registered as AttackCBFunc on the skill hit (both Press and Hold variants). Physical companion effect added 2026-05-09 once Physical landed in the Element union.
Airborne portion (additional -12% RES while airborne) not modeled — gcsim's TODO marker indicates this isn't implemented upstream either.

[Hexerei] Fandom 'Breeze of Reminiscence' constellation infobox, buffType=Hexerei buff field: under Secret Rite the shred becomes a flat 'Anemo RES and Physical RES by 24% for 10s' (the airborne +12% clause is gone from the buff text). The 24% version is authored in factionBonuses with conditions all[teamFaction hexerei >=2, constellation 2].

[Hexerei] 2026-08-15: the two base -12% effects are now gated `not(teamFaction hexerei >=2)`. They previously carried NO condition, with the note that gating them off 'would erase the shred window entirely in a Hexerei team' — true at the time, because factionBonuses were not consumed by the planner. They are now (docs/rounds/faction-bonuses-round.md), so the mutual exclusion is both safe and REQUIRED: without it a Hexerei team draws the -12% and the -24% as two shred bars off one skill hit, which is not a thing that happens in game. The rule: a faction bonus that CHANGES AN EXISTING NUMBER re-authors it under a gate. Contrast C6 Storm of Defiance, whose shreds the rite leaves untouched and which therefore carry no gate.

[Hexerei] Same buff field, unauthored parts: after the burst Venti gains 'Wherever a Breeze Blows' and the skill CD is reset; a Windsunder Arrow hit has a 25% chance to grant it too. Wherever a Breeze Blows = press-skill deals 300% of original DMG, lasts 15s, consumed by the press. The 300% is damage-only. The CD reset is rotation-relevant but would be inert as a factionBonuses cdReset (not collected by the planner) — carried as a caveat instead.

constellations.name: Hurricane of Freedom
_curatorNotes: Stub-with-caveat (decided 2026-05-14, onParticleReceived category): manual trigger preserved because particle pickup is non-deterministic in the planner (out-of-scope per tool constitution). gcsim source: event.OnParticleReceived gated on c.Core.Player.Active() == c.Index() — fires when ANY elemental orb/particle is caught by Venti on-field. Re-evaluate only if particle-gen modelling ever enters scope (unlikely).

[Hexerei] Fandom 'Hurricane of Freedom' constellation infobox, buffType=Hexerei buff field: under Secret Rite the trigger changes from orb/particle pickup to 'After unleashing his Elemental Skill Skyward Sonnet or Elemental Burst Wind's Grand Ode, Venti and his own active party members gain a 25% Anemo DMG Bonus for 10s.' Authored in factionBonuses as two onCast effects (skill, burst) with conditions all[teamFaction hexerei >=2, constellation 4], target ['self','active'] — 'his own active party members' read as the active character, mirroring the Fischl Secret Rite target shape.

[Hexerei] 2026-08-15: the base manual-trigger effect is now gated `not(teamFaction hexerei >=2)`. The rite REPLACES the trigger (orb/particle pickup becomes a skill/burst cast), it does not add a second buff — so once factionBonuses render (docs/rounds/faction-bonuses-round.md), leaving the toggle available in a Hexerei team would let a reader stack a manual 25% on top of the automatic 25% that already fires. Below 2 Hexerei the toggle is unchanged and is still the only way this buff appears.

[A7] Original user text noted the C4 buff fires only while Venti is active on-field at pickup; dropped from the rewrite as a minor nuance since the buff is a manual toggle regardless of on-field state. Already documented in the existing curator notes (gcsim OnParticleReceived gated on Active()==Index).

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — A blank where a +25% Anemo DMG bar belongs. The base effect is `trigger: 'manual'` gated `not(hexerei ≥ 2)`, so in an ordinary team a C4 owner sees no bar at any point in the rotation, and the first sentence explains the blank. ⛔ The SECOND sentence is `working-behavior` — the Hexerei path genuinely fires as two authored onCast factionBonuses effects and draws correctly, so it describes the tool doing its job and should come out. Category: expected-but-absent.

↻ EFFECT RETIRED 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/rounds/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C4 — Hurricane of Freedom — effects[0] (buff anemoDmgBonus 25) carried `trigger: manual` and reached no surface. gcsim: `internal/characters/venti/cons.go:61-77` (`c4`) — `event.OnParticleReceived`, gated on `c.Core.Player.Active() == c.Index()`, adds a 600f `AnemoP = 0.25` `StatMod`. Retained: , unchanged: the 2026-05-14 ruling that orb/particle pickup is non-deterministic and out of scope per the tool constitution ("re-evaluate only if particle-gen modelling ever enters scope"), and the gcsim gate (`OnParticleReceived` + on-field). Rewrite only the 2026-08-15 `not(hexerei ≥ 2)` note, whose whole purpose was to stop a manual toggle stacking on the automatic Hexerei copy — with the base effect gone the gate goes with it. ⚠️ None to the Hexerei path: the Secret Rite behaviour is a SEPARATE, already-live pair of `onCast` effects in `factionBonuses` ("Secret Rite: Hurricane of Freedom (C4)", skill + burst, `target: ["self","active"]`, 10s), and the rite REPLACES the pickup trigger rather than adding a second buff — so deleting the base effect cannot create a blank in a Hexerei team and cannot double-fire in any team. Below 2 Hexerei a C4 owner simply has no bar, which is what the screen already shows, since `manual` never drew one. Both the parse and the TB index are byte-identical: `deriveCapabilities` has skipped `manual` since 2026-09-15, and `target: 'self'` emits no family chip regardless.

↻ RETIRED 2026-09-17 (T1.5): the second, element-less resShred. An absent `element` means ALL-Elemental (Zhongli's Jade Shield uses it that way), so every C6 burst drew a −20% All Elemental RES bar where the game lowers one element, and only after an absorption — a wrong value, not an approximation. Absorption is unmodelled (no absorb path in the sim), so the shred cannot be gated; the Anemo Traveler C6 form stands in: the Anemo half drawn, the absorbed half caveated.

Not authored: it boosts Venti's own hits only, is tied to the enemy debuff rather than a stated duration, and inventing one would fake timing.
